context: This evaluates the ability to create and use superagent plugins to extend request functionality in a reusable way.

checklist.name: Plugin function signature
checklist.description: Creates loggingPlugin as a function that accepts a request parameter and returns the modified request

checklist.name: Modify request in plugin
checklist.description: Uses request.set() within the plugin to add the custom headers

checklist.name: Return request
checklist.description: Returns the request object from the plugin to enable chaining

checklist.name: Use plugin
checklist.description: Uses the use() method in fetchWithLogging to apply the plugin to the request
